name: mvmAI
description: AI chat assistant with shell access. Talk to any OpenAI-compatible provider (Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Ollama, custom). The assistant can run commands on the server on your behalf, with configurable confirmation and safety levels.

credit_features.name: AI chat message
credit_features.description: Charged once per message sent to mvmAI from its public page.
